Next steps: (a) investigate the abandonment increase; (b) at the review, decide whether to accept the trade-off, which requires an explicit prereg change; (c) have the prereg authors confirm whether the margins are relative or absolute, since that flips the guardrail result; (d) re-pull the Pulse snapshot to confirm the full 14-day window. Abandonment Rate +2.2% relative (CI +1.5% to +2.9%). It is the guardrail breach that drives the decision. The primary win is real but within 0.0001 of the bar. The margin definition. The prereg doesn't say whether margins are absolute or relative, and under an absolute reading the abandonment breach disappears. The document also flags that the Pulse snapshot may be a day short of the window, and that about 45 uncorrected segment slices are exploratory only.
